result.summary: Analysis identified minor styling and layout issues regarding text truncation and carousel edge spacing.

issues.description: The third restaurant title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated prematurely as 'Trattoria Piccol'.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line wrapping or reduce text size to prevent truncation.

issues.description: The category chips at the top clip abruptly at the screen edge without visual scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fading or adjust end padding to indicate horizontal scrollability.
